C0958.title: Suzhou Reports Fraudulent Real-Name Attendance Practices
keywords: Suzhou Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau
C0958.summary: In the first half of 2022, the Suzhou Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau identified four projects with fraudulent real-name attendance practices. Project managers Yao and Wu, along with project supervisors, were found to have used photos to falsify attendance records. The involved entities and individuals were publicly criticized, had 0.6 points deducted from their corporate credit files,

references.title: ...14 Projects and Entities Fined for Violations! Some Project Managers and Directors Had Issues with Photo Real-Name...
